newsitem.title: USA: SEC ends Jaron Equities broker-dealer registration.
newsitem.headline: SEC ends Jaron Equities broker-dealer registration.

text.p: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission said Thursday it had revoked the broker-dealer registration of Jaron Equities Corp for failing to disclose its true owner.

The commission's New York office said in a statement it had also permanently barred Sheridan Manhattan Group Inc and Dermot Sheridan from any investment activity. It said the two entities also failed to report Jaron's true owner.
It said it had begun public administrative proceedings against Jaron.
Officials of Jaron, Sheridan Manhattan and Dermot Sheridan could not immediately be reached for comment.
